title: 第21章意料之外感谢普通防御塔第22章冲突前夜
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
师父说罢，再度环顾了一遍屋子，方才走了出去。
许峰留在屋舍之中，也眯着眼睛，不知道在想甚么。
门虽然被掩上了，可是并未关上。师父走下去之后，就有一阵子阴风传来，想要打开这门，只不过未曾得逞，阴风一出来，就被另外一股子力关上了。
是“阴德庇护”！
是有“人”在帮助许峰掩上门！
见到此幕，许峰低声说道：“还没开始，就如此急躁了！”
这一阵风来的蹊跷，和自己师父前面说的话一印证，更是显的这一阵风不怀好意。
要是几天前的许峰，或许是已经开始紧张了。
可是现在的许峰，不但无发麻之模样，手还贴在了怀里。在他的怀里，还有些剩余的香灰。香灰，护身符，再加上许峰的些许胆气，这么一点子的阴风就算是进来，也要被他呵斥散开！
甚至连寻常的诈尸，也能被他呵斥的再度躺下！
更何况他还有阴德庇护在身，这样多的正面增益加持之下，对于这一阵风，许峰能怕甚么？
只是许峰也清楚，这些都不过是开胃菜罢了。今天晚上，社庙之中注定不平静！就连他的师父，都忧心忡忡。
缝尸还未曾开始。
就已经有了这样的幺蛾子出现。
要是等到缝尸开始了。
谁知道还会有什么样子的波折。
不过对于今晚即将发生的一场恶战，许峰现在心情“平静无波”了起来。主要是诸多情绪，也须得皮囊肉身里头的精气神作为燃料。
今天燃了太多，有些燃不太动了。
反而是这些天所学的东西，都在他的脑子之中徐徐闪过，往日所学，就像是积累。
今夜所见，不过是一场考学。

作为因为卷而猝死的许峰，对于这种感觉无比的熟悉。这是一种他熟悉的节奏。
独自坐在了此处，等待着今晚考校的到来。
他闪过了知识点之后，就只是枯坐着，脑中一片清明。
但是奇怪的是，师父下去后半晌，都未曾上来。
且不久之后，他还听到了师父所说的“叫丧门”。
至于可以说是“打”门的声音。
其中还伴随着哭嚎。
许峰眯着眼睛，感觉事情越发的有趣。
底下是嘈杂的说话声音，许是因为恐慌，又或者是因为别的原因，那底下说话的声音都有些走调了，要是许峰愿意的话，他也能半听半猜，知道底下之人在说什么。
不过许峰没有自寻烦恼。
等到声音逐渐平息之后，许峰就听到了风的声音，呜呜呜的乱吹，像是有人在哭泣。
再过了一会儿，这才有人上楼，推开了门。
许峰一只手捏着香灰，一只手握住了旁边的椅子，抬头看着走进来的人，看到是师父之后，他松开了手。
不过此刻，师父脸上无一丝笑容，十分郑重，他察觉到了许峰的动作，不过没在意，而是说道：“来了大活了。”
他示意许峰和他一起下去，哪怕风这样大，许峰也在下楼之后，在院子里头嗅到了奇异的味道。
这一种味道和他上一次在院子之中，不被允许出来的时候，院子里头留下来的味道是一样的。
也就是说，就在他不得出来的时候，院子之中来了同一个人。
许峰看着自己前面的师父手拿松木火把，噼噼啪啪的爆出火星子，在前面走，许峰在后面顺便抬头。
content_en:
After the master finished speaking, he looked around the room again before walking out.
Xu Feng stayed in the house and squinted his eyes, not knowing what he was thinking.
Although the door was closed, it was not closed. After the master walked down, there was a burst of evil wind, and he tried to open the door, but he failed. As soon as the evil wind came out, it was closed by another force.
It's "Yin De shelter"!
There is "someone" helping Xu Feng close the door!
Seeing this scene, Xu Feng whispered: "I haven't even started yet, but I'm already so impatient!"
The strangeness of this gust of wind corroborates what my master said before, and it is even more obvious that this gust of wind has evil intentions.
Xu Feng might have started to get nervous a few days ago.
But now Xu Feng not only didn't look numb, but his hands were still in his arms. In his arms, there were some remaining incense ash. With incense ash, amulets, and a little bit of Xu Feng's courage, even if such a small amount of evil wind comes in, he will be scolded and dispersed!
Even an ordinary corpse trick can be made to lie down again by his scolding!
What's more, he still has Yin De to protect him. With so many positive blessings, what can Xu Feng fear about this gust of wind?
But Xu Feng also knew that these were just appetizers. Tonight, there is definitely no peace in the temple! Even his master was worried.
The sewing has not yet begun.
There has already been such a moth appearing.
If you wait until the sewing begins.
Who knows what kind of twists and turns there will be.
However, regarding the fierce battle that is about to take place tonight, Xu Feng is now in a "calm" mood. Mainly, many emotions also need the energy and spirit in the skin and body as fuel.
There was too much burning today, and some of it can’t be moved anymore.
On the contrary, what he has learned these days is slowly flashing through his mind, and what he has learned in the past is like accumulation.
What I saw tonight was just an exam.
As Xu Feng, who died suddenly due to curling, he is extremely familiar with this feeling. It was a rhythm he was familiar with.
Sitting here alone, waiting for the exam tonight.
After he passed the knowledge points, he just sat there, his mind clear.
But the strange thing is that Master didn't come up even after he went down for a long time.
And not long after, he also heard what his master said was "called the Sangmen".
As for the sound that can be said to be "hitting" on the door.
There were also cries and howls.
Xu Feng squinted his eyes, feeling that things were getting more interesting.
There were noisy voices below. Perhaps because of panic or for other reasons, the voices below were a little out of tune. If Xu Feng was willing, he could half-listen and half-guess what the people below were saying.
But Xu Feng didn't look for trouble.
After the sound gradually subsided, Xu Feng heard the sound of the wind, blowing randomly, as if someone was crying.
After a while, someone came upstairs and opened the door.
Xu Feng held the incense ashes in one hand and held the chair next to him with the other. He looked up at the person who came in. When he saw that it was Master, he let go of his hand.
But at this moment, there was no smile on the master's face. He was very solemn. He noticed Xu Feng's movements, but didn't pay attention. Instead, he said: "Here comes the big job."
He motioned Xu Feng to go down with him. Even though the wind was so strong, Xu Feng smelled a strange smell in the yard after going downstairs.
This smell was the same as the smell left in the yard the last time he was in the yard and was not allowed to come out.
In other words, just when he was not allowed to come out, the same person came into the courtyard.
Xu Feng looked at the master in front of him who was holding a pine torch and crackling sparks. He was walking in front, while Xu Feng raised his head behind him.
